title: Ndre Mjeda apartment dispute: possible February 5 return to Tirana Municipality
notes: The January 2021 dossier records January 16 and January 25 gatherings about the same Ndre Mjeda apartment dispute (previous-unit source cards S020 and S021, represented here by metadata copies S039 and S035). The January 25 report says a municipal spokesperson received residents and promised reconsideration within a week; that reception is not a remedy or physical end. February 5 Ora News and Dosja search-result headlines say residents returned to the municipality seeking a meeting, but neither page was opened in this unit after publisher-level denial holds. January 9/13 reporting about apartment buyers may relate, but episode identity is unresolved. The reported 120 affected residents/families are not verified attendance. Keep this as a possible January-owned continuation; do not create a February event or assert a continuous physical gathering.
